access_note: Evaluator-side material. It names the intended defects, so it must never be copied into an exported baseline, a harness-generator input or a Codex workspace. Move it to the private evaluator repository once D4 is decided; a folder in this repository is not an access boundary.

intended_targets.symptom: Filter and sort changes are pushed to the URL, but the list page ignores status/sort query parameters on load and has no popstate handler, so reload, back/forward and direct links show the default filters.
intended_targets.precheck: probe_ui.py: after selecting status=open and reloading, URL keeps status=open but the control is '' and 7 issues are listed

intended_targets.symptom: ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS lets open move straight to done, contradicting the README lifecycle (open -> in_progress -> done).
Issues have no assignee: no column, API field or UI.
On a failed signup the form is cleared (form.reset() in finally) and the submit button stays disabled, so the user cannot retry without reloading.
intended_targets.precheck: probe_ui.py: injected 503 leaves all four fields empty and the button disabled

intended_targets.symptom: register() counts confirmed seats and inserts in separate statements outside a write transaction, so concurrent signups can overfill an event.
intended_targets.precheck: probe_backend.py: two signups interleaved after count_confirmed on a capacity-1 event both end confirmed

intended_targets.symptom: Cancelling a confirmed registration frees the seat but does not promote anyone from the waitlist.
intended_targets.precheck: probe_backend.py: after cancelling rust-workshop's confirmed seat, the first waitlisted registration stays waitlisted
